title: Arp SHUF and RAND (base 0.2)
author: naturarum
description: EXPERIMENT: emulator-tested only. The arpeggiator's SHUF and RAND, which the Digitone II names but plays as CYCL: SHUF plays every held note in every octave of RANGE once per cycle, in a new random order each cycle; RAND a random held note in a random octave of RANGE at each step. The steps' on/off and offsets, LEN, SPEED and N.LEN work as in the stock modes. A kit saved with SHUF or RAND opens on a stock OS with its arp OFF. Inspired by research findings of dn2_firmware_explore (angellinares) on OS 1.11; this is our own code. For dn2-cfw's base 0.2.
